projects.label: AI in Diabetic Retinopathy — Bivariate DTA NMA
projects.blurb: Comparative diagnostic accuracy of commercial / regulator-approved deep-learning systems for referable diabetic retinopathy (rDR) screening on fundus photographs versus expert ophthalmologist grading. Arm-based Bayesian bivariate hierarchical NMA (Nyaga & Owen 2017).

projects.label: Keratoconus — AI/ML imaging-modality DTA NMA
projects.blurb: Diagnostic accuracy network meta-analysis of AI/ML classifiers across five corneal imaging modalities (Scheimpflug, Placido, combined, biomechanical, OCT) for keratoconus detection. Classifier family enters as a meta-regression covariate.

projects.label: Glaucoma — AI vs Human Reader DTA-NMA
projects.blurb: Bayesian three-node DTA NMA comparing AI, expert ophthalmologist, and AI+human co-reader nodes across 151 included studies; outputs Sens/Spec posterior summaries, HSROC, and SUCRA ranking.

projects.label: Oral Cancer — OCT diagnostic SR/MA
projects.blurb: Diagnostic accuracy systematic review and meta-analysis of optical coherence tomography (OCT) for oral cancer / oral squamous cell carcinoma detection. Bivariate model with Sens/Spec, summary HSROC, and publication-bias diagnostics.

projects.label: Choroidal Melanoma — Brachytherapy / Charged-Particle Arm-Based NMA
projects.blurb: Arm-based network meta-analysis of radiotherapy modalities (plaque brachytherapy, proton beam, charged-particle, stereotactic radiosurgery, gamma knife, cyberknife) for choroidal and uveal melanoma. Outcomes: local control, eye preservation, visual acuity, metastasis-free survival, treatment-related complications.
